title: Rav Kahana son of Rav Nechemyah

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 71b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.71b.5-6). The notice adds: “Rava said.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Yevamot gives an explanation by Rava followed by one from Rav Kahana son of Rav Nechemyah. The brief source fragment says “Rava said” and does not expressly make Kahana his transmitter.
